We can plan for the future or understand our feelings better. Finally, staying alone helps us focus more. Without noise from other people, we can finish our work faster. In short, a little 'me time' makes us feel happier and more energetic.

However, I sometimes use e-books when I travel because they are very light and can hold many stories.

Also, we can find information and look up new words quickly on the internet while reading. However, some people still like the traditional way because they don't want to look at screens for too long.

We now have modern gyms with many machines and professional equipment. Also, even elderly people now join fitness classes to stay healthy, which was not very common before. In short, exercise has become a choice rather than a necessity of life.

Finally, it gives you more motivation to exercise because you don't want to let your team down.

In my opinion, people like to decorate their homes for two reasons. First, it makes the house look more beautiful and comfortable to live in. When you have a nice room, you feel more relaxed after work. Second, decorating is a way to show your personality. For example, some people like modern styles while others like traditional things. In Vietnam, we especially love decorating our houses before the Lunar New Year to welcome luck into our lives.
